comment: Shared split template for MoSim robot mods, derived from https://docs.mosimulator.com (modding intro + 9496 Lynk walkthrough). Both the web UI and the desktop app read this file — edit it to change your workflow. Keep ids stable or saved progress will detach.

subs.label: Export CAD assembly to GLTF — name it Team(Year), coarse quality
Swap to simplified swerve modules (big perf win)
Import into Blender with Merge Vertices; delete default cube/light/camera
Optimize mesh: merge verts, limited dissolve, decimate, weighted normal
Export as Team(Year).fbx and clean up the GLTF
Open the MoSim Unity project
Set External Script Editor (Rider / VS Code / VS 2022) + Unity extension
Create pack folder under Prefabs/<Game>/Robots/Mods
Create ModpackMetadata scriptable object and fill fields
Copy an example robot folder (e.g. 2910) into your pack
Rename + re-fill robot ScriptableObject; add it to the modpack robot list
Import the FBX under Imports/<Game>/Models/Robots/<Team>
Strip example prefab to the drivetrain; drag your model into the hierarchy
Rotate upright (Y up, Z forward); match model height to wheels
Unpack model; create Stationary empty and move static parts into it
Create empties per mechanism (elevator stages, pivots) — never change Y
Sort every part into its mechanism; group meshes under Model empties
Align pivot empties (intake/funnel, arm, climber bar & wedge)
Apply materials/colors from the Materials folder
Box colliders on tubing; compound collider children for odd shapes
Separate collider children wherever game pieces interact
Assign physics materials (NoBounce / noFricBounce for most)
Set layer to Robot on root + all children (even if it looks set)
Move wheels to match the real robot
Create robot class from the RobotBase template (setpoint switch)
Create the Setpoint ScriptableObject class
Declare elevator/joints + PIDs; SetPid in Start, UpdatePid in LateUpdate
Target fields + SetSetpoint / UpdateSetpoints helpers
Fill the setpoint switch (incl. Place / LastSetpoint logic)
Game piece controllers: preload, stow states, RequestIntake per mode
PlacePiece / release-with-force logic
Strip root prefab; add robot script, GenericElevator, GamePiece Controller
GenericJoints on stages/arms — set axes + connected bodies
Configure elevator: stage order, type, PID, height/overlap/carriage
Create setpoint SO assets and assign them all
Intake empties with trigger colliders (speed, force, distance, accuracy)
Set Robot Spawn override; robot spawns in play mode
Tune setpoint heights/angles until they score
Set release forces in PlacePiece so pieces actually score
Fix collider/intake bugs; GenericJoints ignore Robot layer (drift)
Add + tune Auto Align for consistency (L4, then L1)
Mass tweaks on light parts (e.g. pivots to ~2 lbs)
Climber joints: disable automatic tensor; set up setpoints
Climb scorer + trigger box on the cage scoring trigger
Import team logo, set texture settings, assign it
Main-menu display prefab (copy root, strip all components)
Fill out the tutorial cards
Addressables group: drag mod folder in; add modpack_metadata label
Set custom build/load paths; Include In Build only your mod
Build with Default Build Script
Collect .bundle + catalog.hash/json + settings.json + mod DLL into one folder
Drop into the Mods folder and test in MoSim
Build Win/macOS/Linux, zip, publish download links, submit for review
